scope: Public-use CDC NHANES 1999-2016 nine cycles; 50+ observed data and CBC biomarkers; not an author-identical FI reconstruction
authority: All NHANES datasets/codebooks downloaded from wwwn.cdc.gov. Data is public use. CDC terms: https://wwwn.cdc.gov/nchs/nhanes/continuousnhanes/overview.aspx?BeginYear=2015
software: Locally authored Python downloader/preparer. uv script dependencies pandas==3.0.3. No third-party FI source code reused.

author_code_search.result: No code attributable to Han 2024 was located in this bounded search. This is not proof no code exists.
author_code_search.why_not_used: Different 53-item index, includes partial scores that conflict with Han binary description; not established author provenance. Code not copied so license-based reuse not applicable.

important_mapping_issues: 2015 source files contain candidates for all 36 S1 concepts, but mapping is analyst-selected and thresholds/denominator not supplied by Han.
1999 MCQ160I asks another thyroid disease; goiter is separate MCQ160H, whereas 2001 MCD160M and later MCQ160M ask thyroid problem.
2001 uses adjusted LBDSLDSI and LBDSAPSI instead of LBXSLDSI and LBXSAPSI. Current published adjusted values retained.
2001 L40_2_B repeat-exam convenience sample cached but excluded from analysis.
HUQ050 and HUQ051 are ordinal healthcare-frequency bins and wording/bin boundaries changed. Never interpret their codes as visit counts.
HUQ010 and HSD010 collect health status in home versus MEC interviews; participants can give different answers; do not merge blindly.
PFQ061 (early PFQ060) code 5 means does not do activity. Refused/dont-know codes and skip-driven missing values require explicit handling.
Some 50-59 year olds skip PFQ difficulty items after negative screening responses. Missingness is partly structural.
Prescription file is medicine-level long. RXDCOUNT/RXD295 and RXDUSE/RXD030 were checked for within-person consistency and retained once.
DIQ010=3 is borderline diabetes, and its binary deficit interpretation is unspecified in Han.
BPX contains up to four systolic/diastolic measurements; Han does not identify which to use or aggregation rule.
Public-use age is topcoded differently across cycles; RIDAGEYR preserved as released.
All original observed-code variables retain special missing sentinel values; NaN-only filtering is insufficient for questionnaires.
No FI or frailty group is calculated in prepare_nhanes.py. Downstream candidate rules must be versioned and explicitly distinguished from Han author implementation.
parser_correction: pandas3.0.3 read_sas XPORT converted IBM zero to exact16**-65. Replaced only that exact numeric representation with0. R4.6.1 foreign0.8.91 crosscheck of6files268632values confirmed all zero classifications and numeric values. See xpt_zero_crosscheck.json.
candidate_implementation: Downstream analyst-specified operational36 candidate exists in construct_fi_candidate.py and config/fi_candidate.json. It is not author-identical recovered coding. Prepared observed CSV itself has no FI.
